text: 周五（10月2日）欧市尾盘，法国10年期国债收益率跌4.9个基点，报4.870%，北京时间20:00（美国非农就业报告出炉前半小时）曾达到4.995%——继续逼近2002年三季度顶部5.115%、1996年四季度最高位6.114%，本周累计上涨17.9个基点，整体持续走高。 两年期法债收益率涨5.6个基点，报3.738%，本周累涨17.1个基点；30年期法债收益率跌10.7个基点，报5.430%，本周累涨16.5个基点。 意大利10年期国债收益率跌8.8个基点，报4.606%，本周累涨9.5个基点；30年期意债收益率跌12.5个基点，报5.150%，本周
text_en: Friday (October 2) at the late European session, the French 10-year government bond yield fell 4.9 basis points to 4.870%, having reached 4.995% at 20:00 Beijing time (half an hour before the U.S. nonfarm payrolls report was released) — continuing to approach the third-quarter 2002 peak of 5.115% and the fourth-quarter 1996 high of 6.114%, rising 17.9 basis points cumulatively this week and continuing to rise overall. The two-year French bond yield rose 5.6 basis points to 3.738%, rising 17.1 basis points cumulatively this week; the 30-year French bond yield fell 10.7 basis points to 5.430%, rising 16.5 basis points cumulatively this week. The Italian 10-year government bond yield fell 8.8 basis points to 4.606%, rising 9.5 basis points cumulatively this week; the 30-year Italian bond yield fell 12.5 basis points to 5.150%, this week
